qualification: Rust-owned five-family OpenAPI HTTP projection prototype

source.contract: Rust sdk-openapi-prototype Actors, Workers, Stream, Objects and Inference documents

archive_format: deterministic ZIP with sorted UTF-8 relative paths and DOS epoch entry timestamps

tests.install: Each family archive was expanded into an isolated installed/<family> directory; consumers imported the extracted module manifest.
vectors: Actors invokeActor preserves AQID request/response bytes and status 200
Workers invokeDeployment uses Rust-emitted byte[] base64 adaptation, decodes response bytes, and preserves uint64 18446744073709551615
Stream read preserves AQID record bytes and max uint64 sequence; generated 503 error raises and is observed by the consumer
Objects put preserves AQID request and etag/size response
Inference generate preserves AQID context and max uint64 request/response values
Bearer authentication reaches every fixture route

license_scope.generated_template: OpenAPI Generator Apache-2.0 project; generated package metadata carries the Apache license URI
license_scope.rust_contract: Rust source and projection license scope remains separate from generated module metadata
license_scope.dependencies: No global dependency license closure is asserted; package is local-only pending module/runtime review

limits: HTTP/JSON projection only; no protobuf/gRPC, native or embedded behavior is qualified
One representative operation per family was exercised; full operation/model validation remains outstanding
Stream recovery is only explicit caller-observed 503 handling; no automatic retry policy is implemented
The generated PowerShell client has no operation cancellation primitive or endpoint-pool recovery policy
Workers byte[] adaptation is Rust-emitted and anchor-checked; other family byte fields remain generated base64 JSON values
No PowerShell Gallery publication or redistributable dependency closure is claimed
